decision.reason: The preregistered promotion rule requires every seed to retain or improve both actual losses and all construction, evidence, request and public-retention gates. encoded_state seed 43 and all state-only seeds worsen generated loss. Retain forecast-v1, despite lower single-step latency and two improved encoded_state seeds.
remaining: Public numeric extraction and demand calibration remain weak.
The earlier frozen generated Test missed 240.35; it was not used again.
Controlled Dev and identical-input invariance do not prove real organizational effectiveness.

privateStorage.restore: Extract to /dev/shm/newsvendor-state-value-v1 to preserve the original linkedManifest paths. Source datasets and the recorded forecast-v1 parent remain required by strict checkpoint loading.

limitations: The same repeatedly used Dev, not a blind Test: 60 generated cases/12 families and 336 retail cases. Exact retail losses use five complete periods crossed with seven controlled financial conditions.
Three random seeds share one pretrained constructor and one dataset. They do not provide three independent organizational samples.
Both heads are freshly initialized with the same seed and width, but have different input dimensions, parameter counts and random-number layouts.
Both conditions use the same collection rule and maximum budget; their own-state policies visit different states and may stop after different numbers of epochs.
State-only values are invariant only when the supplied numeric state, costs and permitted actions agree. The summary may omit other useful observed information.
Demand weights are frozen. No improvement in demand calibration or latent-stockout identification is established.

Candidate and optimizer archives are preserved locally. Published small candidate heads require the corresponding frozen full-model base; the existing portable parent release remains a separate artifact.
